subject: The secret workflow 99% of users never discover
preview_text: Our top 1% of users do this one thing differently. It changes everything about how they spot red flags.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing user data last week and noticed something strange. The users who catch toxic patterns earliest—the ones who avoid months of heartbreak—aren't just scanning random texts. They're doing something specific that 99% of users miss completely.

Our top 1% don't wait for fights or weird texts. They set up a system. Every Sunday evening, they scan their three most significant conversations from the week. Not just the bad ones—the good ones too. Because patterns hide in the normal moments, not just the explosions. They're looking for the slow creep, the subtle shifts in language, the tiny manipulations that build over time. They treat their relationships like gardens—checking weekly for weeds before they take over.

That's why we built the Pattern Timeline feature. It connects your weekly scans into a visual map of your relationship's health. You can literally watch toxicity develop over weeks or months. The top users aren't just scanning—they're building evidence. They're creating a clear picture instead of relying on gut feelings that get gaslit away.

Open the app right now and scan your last three meaningful conversations. Don't wait for a red flag to punch you in the face. Build your timeline starting today. P.S. The users who do this weekly are 3x more likely to spot manipulation before it becomes irreversible damage.
